{{Top|leg}}
A '''servo-grip''' was the servo-powered hand or gripping apparatus on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Servo-grip was but one of several methods to activate the [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] of a droid, the others being pneumatic, hydraulic, or magnetic.
